body.name: Covariance-region projection
body.construction: Form \(\mathcal C_n\), retain every pair \((M,\rho)\) with \(M\in\mathcal C_n\) whose exact root signatures computed from \(M\) by \(\text{def:root-signature}\) use at most \(K\) values, and project the retained pairs through \(\theta_\rho(M;x,y)\) to obtain \(\widehat\Theta_{K,n}\).
